title: Three Years and One Short Tool
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：profession　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 profession 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the craftsman ① entered the profession that no apprentice in the workshop would have noted, and he said the entering was the whole of the year. The ② profession, meaning the career itself and not the tool, ran three years and stayed unnoted in the book; a profession, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ profession in that workshop had the same short tool beside it, and the ④ profession at the far bench, meaning the order they kept for the children to finish and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A profession, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the craftsman said the noting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the profession was the whole of the matter, meaning the calling and not the career. The ⑥ profession, meaning the calling and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; profession, he said, is either something you enter or the only word that means both a career and a calling. He said the calling is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ profession had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short tool. The ⑧ profession of the whole thing, the craftsman wrote in August, was one workshop and three years of noting; profession, he said, is either the order at the far bench or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ profession I remember is the career noted in the ledger, which closed in 1983 and is still noted as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ profession, my mother said in 1985, is the only career that improves by being noted; every profession, she said, is a calling that has agreed to look like a career. She said the calling was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 职业（指工坊里每一门旁边的那一门）
B. n. 职业（指那门职业本身，与小小的工具相对）
C. 固定搭配：enter the profession 入这一门职业
D. n. 职业（指留给孩子们赶完的那一桩）
E. n. 职业之事（抽象总称，指一处工坊的职业之事）
F. n. 职业（指工料簿里写到、被记下的那一门）
G. n. 职业、志业（指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 志业（抽象总称，指人人都做却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: entered the profession that no apprentice in the workshop would have noted
The profession, meaning the career itself and not the tool
the profession at the far bench
the profession was the whole of the matter

The profession of the whole thing

answers.why: enter the profession 意为“入这一门职业”，1976 年那位匠人把工坊里没有一位学徒肯记下的一门职业做了一遍。
profession 意为“职业”，指那门职业本身而不是小小的工具，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记下。
profession 意为“职业”，指工坊里每一门旁边的那一门，每一门旁边都有同一件小小的工具。
profession 意为“职业”，指最远那张案台的留给孩子们赶完的那一桩，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
profession 意为“职业、志业”，指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这门志业就是那件事的全部。
profession 意为“志业”，指人人都做却无人提起的那样东西而不是那门职业，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
profession 意为“职业”，指工料簿里写到、被记下的那一门，到 1981 年这一门成了工料簿里的一行。
profession 意为“职业之事”，匠人八月写道，整件事的职业之事是一处工坊和三个年头的记下。
profession 意为“职业”，我记得的是工料簿里记下过的那一门，1983 年出师了，至今仍被说成工坊里最安静的一门。
profession 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，职业是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的职业。
